lines.rom: arati sri sai guruvara ki paramananda sada suravara ki ja ki krpa vipula sukhakari duhkha soka samkata bhayahari
sirdi mem avatara racaya camatkara se tattva dikhaya kitane bhakta carana para aye ve sukha santi ciramtana paye
bhava dharai jo mana mem jaisa pavata anubhava vo hi vaisa guru ki udi lagave tana ko samadhana labhata usa mana ko
sai nama sada jo gave so phala jaga mem sasvata pave guruvasara kari puja seva usa para krpa karata gurudeva

rama krsna hanumana rupa mem de darsana janata jo mana mem vividha dharma ke sevaka ate darsana kara icchita phala pate
jai bolo sai baba ki jai bolo avadhuta guru ki saidasa arati ko gavai ghara mem basi sukha mamgala pave
